botSweep.brief: Melt every beta unit and the update relay before the timer ends. Watch first; good robots still have work to do.
botSweep.win: Pilot closed. Every beta unit stopped.
botSweep.lose: The relay completed its update. Reset the pilot and try again.

cleanStreets.brief: Confirm the posted robots and earn more points than the other team. Wrong targets cost points.
cleanStreets.win: More evidence. Fewer incidents. Your team takes the board.
cleanStreets.lose: The other team closed more cases. The next board starts fresh.

tasks.instruction: Place a cone on the marked robotaxi. Walk away at an ordinary pace.
Send the update to the marked AI robot. Its light will flicker while it transfers.
Attach the ad to the marked board. The corner ping follows in five seconds.
Take the bag from the marked AI delivery robot, then blend into the route.

hideInTheCrowd.briefHider: Complete tasks while following ordinary robot routines. Avoid obvious detours.
hideInTheCrowd.briefSpotter: Watch behaviour, compare tells, and use your limited scans carefully.

fogRoyale.win: Raised a Series A in this market.
fogRoyale.out: Your calendar is full. Spectating is now the only available slot.

vibesNight.brief: Run a clean three-robot demo. The simulation scores the work; players vote for the Vibes Award.
vibesNight.vote: Vote for the demo you want to remember. You cannot vote for yourself.
vibesNight.tie: Tied votes use a deterministic keyed-hash tie-break. The demo scores stay separate.

provenance.review: Imported authored catalog; integration checks are recorded separately. Independent editorial review remains pending.
